lockFileMaintenance.description: Cargo.lock carries the transitive dependencies, whose security fixes would otherwise arrive only when a direct dependency happens to move. A weekly refresh keeps them current.

customManagers.description: rust-toolchain.toml pins the Rust every build uses. Track Rust's releases so the pin follows the latest stable; the minimum supported Rust, rust-version in Cargo.toml, is a separate decision and is not bumped.

packageRules.description: ratatui is cut against one crossterm release, and protui depends on crossterm directly only to enable its event stream. One PR per release wave keeps the two resolving to a single crossterm, instead of pairing a new ratatui with an old crossterm.

package.json carries prettier as a caret range and no lockfile is committed, so an in-range release would never open a PR and the recorded version would drift from the one `cargo xtask fmt` resolves. Bump the range to keep the two in step.
